The uptime check on /health saw something other than `"status": "ok"` from two or more regions. A 200 with `degraded` counts: one track failed to load.

1. Which revision is serving: `gcloud run services describe riskwatch --region us-central1 --format='yaml(status.traffic)'`
2. Why: `gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name="riskwatch" AND textPayload:"failed to load"' --limit 20`
3. Roll back without a rebuild: `gcloud run services update-traffic riskwatch --region us-central1 --to-revisions <last good>=100`
